quote: The GIDS doesn't hold you. It holds everything in you — every bolt they put in your shoulder, every mesh they wove through your femur, every chip behind your ear. The tube grabs all of it at once and says: come. For the unaugmented, it's different. I watched a man who'd refused all implants take the punch once. He said it felt like someone had pressed a wall against his entire back simultaneously and held it there for a minute. He said he would not do it again.
source: Ferrogate Transit crew orientation materials, internal document
context: Senior maintenance technician describing GIDS operation to new crew
